title: 국제환규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:19:0:00019:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 19 (Transfer)
(1) A payee or remitter who intends to request transfer shall submit an International Money Order Transfer Request to a post office.
(2) Transfer shall be made by mail or telegraph.
(3) Where card money orders are exchanged under the Money Order Agreement between the remitting country and the country receiving the transfer, no transfer fee shall be collected.
(4) In cases of transfer other than those under paragraph (3), an international money order certificate shall be issued or an international money order list prepared for the balance remaining after deduction of the transfer fee, converted into the currency of denomination pursuant to Article 3 (1), and dispatched to the country receiving the transfer.
